Killing an enemy of the <link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> grants 'Ascendant Escape'. This buff grants <void Invisibility /> for 6+? seconds when you reach Critical Health or take damage while at Critical Health.

// The source gives a 6+? second duration without identifying the bonus or its condition. It does not specify whether granting Invisibility consumes Ascendant Escape.

On Elite+ Kill:
